result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but the horizontal restaurant carousel ('Fastest near you') clips the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') at the right edge with its title truncated, which could read as visually broken. A few minor polish items also exist.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right screen edge, with the restaurant name truncated mid-word and the card partially off-screen, giving a broken/unfinished appearance.
issues.suggestion: Add right-edge padding or a peek-card treatment with a clear scroll affordance (e.g., gradient fade or partial card with consistent spacing) so the truncation looks intentional; ensure the title uses ellipsis with adequate reserved width.

issues.description: Restaurant title 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated without a visible ellipsis, making the text look clipped rather than intentionally shortened.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis with a fixed max-width so truncated titles end cleanly with '…'.

issues.description: The category filter chips ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', etc.) and the 'See all' links rely on color alone to indicate selection/state, and the heart/favorite icons have no visible labels.
issues.suggestion: Provide aria-labels for icon-only buttons (notification bell, favorite hearts) and ensure selected chip state is conveyed beyond color (e.g., bold text or border).

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar's center search icon overlaps the iOS home indicator bar, creating a slightly cramped/overlapping look at the bottom edge.
issues.suggestion: Add safe-area bottom padding so navigation icons sit above the home indicator.
